description: THE event-impact moat: how a fan token reacts when its team SCORES vs CONCEDES a goal, market-adjusted vs CHZ at +15/+30/+60m. The blended 'all goals' number hides the real signal — scoring is ~priced-in, conceding moves price. Returns the scored-vs-conceded decomposition with sample sizes and directional hit rates. Only computable here (needs the token<->team map). Descriptive history, not advice.
